prompt:

Palette/light: Humid green reserve light, weathered ochre city stone, heavy bronze gate hardware, restrained orange transit lamps. Exact asset: One matching-scale right massive gate jamb with exposed locking sockets and broad ochre stone foot, independent full module. Genuinely transparent PNG alpha outside this ONE isolated object, including openings; no checkerboard, solid backdrop or cast shadow. Preserve complete silhouette and leave clear margins.   Camera: strict side-view/front elevation, upright verticals and preserved proportions, never isometric or overhead. NO characters, humanoid statues, creatures, human religious iconography, readable text, letters, logos, watermark, UI, collage or multi-view sheet. Other layers and props are generated separately; do not add them to this image.
CRITICAL SILHOUETTE: this is the RIGHT-hand jamb of an opening. The SOLID pillar body is at IMAGE RIGHT; the locking sockets are on its LEFT edge facing inward toward IMAGE LEFT. No lintel, no projecting beam, no arch and no second pillar. Whole free-standing upright stone-and-bronze module, same front elevation as a side-view fighting-game level. Large clear true transparent margins, completely isolated.
